name: sums files recursively from the root
input: root has nested directories and direct files

name: selects nested directories and individual files
input: queries target a directory and a leaf file
test:
tree = {'home': {'me': {'a.txt': 416, 'src': {'b.py': 100}}}, 'bin': {'ls': 20}}
assert total_size(tree, 'home/me') == 516
assert total_size(tree, '/home/me/src/') == 100
assert total_size(tree, '/home/me/a.txt') == 416

name: returns None for missing paths and handles empty directories
input: empty directory, zero-byte file, and absent child
test:
tree = {'empty': {}, 'zero.txt': 0}
assert total_size(tree, 'empty') == 0
assert total_size(tree, '/zero.txt/') == 0
assert total_size(tree, 'missing/') is None
assert total_size(tree, 'zero.txt') == 0

name: queries sibling paths without changing the tree
input: independent sibling directories and a file lookup
